summary: Frontend-only verification completed on preview URL for homepage reference match, responsiveness, regression pages, and live editor integration. Most layout requirements pass at 1440/1920 and responsive breakpoints (320/390/768/1024/1440/1920) with no horizontal overflow. One important editor/navigation interaction issue found.

ui_bugs.issue: When live editor is ON, fixed panel default position (top-right) overlays header area and blocks clicking the Connect nav link on Field Notes page. Reproduced: /?edit=1 -> Field Notes -> click Connect remains on /field-notes.

integration_issues.flow: Homepage media requests while hidden work images
integration_issues.issue: Console repeatedly logs 401 resource failures from hidden work-card media/image requests during homepage load. Visual layout still matches, but integration noise remains.

issues: Measured left rail variance: brandLeft 134.39px vs heroTextLeft 120px (~14px offset).
Footer/content rails align at 120px left; header brand text starts slightly inset relative to content rail.

action_items: Adjust live editor panel default placement or z-index/offset so header navigation (especially Connect) remains clickable while editor is active.
Stop rendering hidden work-card media requests (or ensure accessible media IDs) to remove repeated 401 console errors.
If strict rail alignment is required at 1920, align header brand left edge exactly with content/footer rail.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveEditor click-capture logic is scoped to <main>, but fixed panel placement can still create practical interaction blocking in header.

Homepage reference CSS and block rendering generally satisfy layout constraints (hero text-only, right-column work intro, 2x2 work grid, field-note image proportions, connect links under copy, no overflow).
Field Notes card links currently route to /field-notes index (not detail); functional but worth confirming intended destination behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use wait for '#home-reference .hero-plain .h1' + document.fonts.ready before measurements. Verified responsive matrix (320/390/768/1024/1440/1920) with no overflow and expected stacking behavior. Verified owner login and live editor availability/selectability (image + heading + resize handles). Repro bug is specific to editor panel default overlap with nav Connect on /field-notes while editor is active.
rca of the issue:
RCA (nav block): Live editor panel defaults to top-right and visually overlaps the header/nav hit area. During active editing, Connect nav click target is covered on Field Notes page, so click attempts do not navigate. Mitigation: move panel lower by default, add collision-aware placement, or reduce panel width at desktop breakpoints.

RCA (401 console noise): Work card image nodes still trigger media fetches despite design intending hidden/non-visual media; unresolved/unauthorized media IDs return 401 and clutter console. Mitigation: do not render hidden image tags in reference mode or provide valid public media refs.
